definitions.explanation: A formal agreement between countries, groups, or individuals to work together for a common purpose.

examples.japanese: {軍事|ぐんじ}{同盟|どうめい}を{結|むす}ぶ。
{同盟|どうめい}{国|こく}と{協力|きょうりょく}する。
{日米|にちべい}{同盟|どうめい}

notes:
{同盟|どうめい} refers to a formal alliance or league, typically between nations or organizations working toward a shared goal.

WORD FORMATION:
{同|どう} (same, together) + {盟|めい} (pledge, oath)

COMMON TYPES:
- {軍事|ぐんじ}{同盟|どうめい}: military alliance
- {政治|せいじ}{同盟|どうめい}: political alliance
- {労働|ろうどう}{同盟|どうめい}: labor union/league

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- {同盟|どうめい}を{結|むす}ぶ: to form an alliance
- {同盟|どうめい}{国|こく}: allied nation
- {同盟|どうめい}{関係|かんけい}: alliance relationship

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {連合|れんごう}: coalition, union (often temporary or broader)
- {協定|きょうてい}: agreement, pact (focused on specific terms)
- {提携|ていけい}: partnership, tie-up (often in business)
